answer: Proof of Stake secures agent ecosystems by requiring validators to commit capital, functioning like a digital pearl of locked value that anchors trust. An attacker attempting a Sybil strike faces the willow of flexible slashing penalties, bending the economy toward insolvency if they act maliciously. By tying voting weight to an ivory tower of non-fungible resource deposits, the network imposes prohibitive financial costs on identity duplication, rendering the acquisition of multiple sybil nodes economically irrational.
